data.one_liner: A plugin for sending and receiving broadcasts with Android intents and iOS notifications.
data.what_it_does: A plugin for sending and receiving broadcasts with Android intents and iOS notifications. The API is inspired by Android's BroadcastReceivers and uses the NotificationCenter internally on iOS.
use_when: You need to handle Android broadcast intents inside a Flutter application
You want to subscribe to native message streams using a BroadcastReceiver-inspired API
avoid_when: You need full iOS NSNotificationCenter support immediately, as it is not yet implemented
You are looking for traditional push notifications via Firebase
strengths: Familiar API design for developers coming from Android's BroadcastReceiver
Stream-based messages integration for easy listening
weaknesses: iOS NSNotificationCenter subscriptions and notifications are not yet implemented
data.setup_notes: Install via pub.dev and instantiate BroadcastReceiver with desired names.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need remote push notifications across platforms instead of local native broadcasts.
